project_type: Vanilla JS multi-page static web app (no bundler). Vietnamese/Chinese flashcard learning app.
language: HTML + plain JavaScript (ES5/ES2015, no modules). CSS in styles.css.
build_system: None — open HTML files directly in browser or serve with any static server (e.g. python -m http.server or VS Code Live Server). No npm build step for the frontend.
test_framework: None — manual browser testing only. Open each HTML file and verify visually.
test_command: Open each HTML page in a browser and verify the page renders correctly and its features work.
verification_instructions: 1. Open the HTML page in a browser (file:// or local static server). 2. Open DevTools console and confirm no JS errors. 3. Verify the specific feature described in each FEAT's acceptance criteria works as expected.
environment_constraints: No bundler, no import/export. All JS files must use plain globals. Script load order in every HTML page: data/data.js (NO defer — must be synchronous) → storage.js → api-client.js → profile.js → js/shared.js → js/[page].js. The original app.js must NOT be deleted or modified.
contribution_requirements: Keep app.js intact. Do not use ES modules (no import/export). All new JS files write to window globals. Shared state is in window.AppState and persisted to localStorage.
key_patterns: 1. State variables are plain globals: level (string), deck (array), fcIdx (int), favorites (array), quizPool/quizAskedWords (arrays), qScore/qTotal (ints), wIdx (int). 2. $ = id => document.getElementById(id) helper is used throughout. 3. WQStorage module in storage.js handles all localStorage reads/writes. 4. All sections use existing CSS classes from styles.css — do not add new class names. 5. Sidebar nav items use data-section in original; new pages use data-page and href to actual .html files. Active state set by matching location.pathname. 6. The sidebar + header HTML block is identical across all 8 pages. 7. Modals that need to appear on all pages: #profileModal, #wqPopupOverlay, #toastContainer.
